summary: Tested the 3 targeted changes (chat quota 5/10, premium perks text, legal pages + splash color) plus regression (admin panel, login). Backend: wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter14_chat_quota.py (4 tests, fresh TEST_ users each run) - all PASS, confirming GET /api/chat returns numeric remaining/limit for both free (5) and premium (10) users, free user's 6th message returns 429 with Polish 'Wykorzystano ... darmowych pytań' message and remaining stays at 0, premium user's 11th message returns 429 with Polish 'Wykorzystano ... Premium' message. Frontend (Playwright, 375x667): logged in as ania_t1 (free), chat header showed 'Darmowe pytania dziś: 4' then decremented to 0 after 4 real sends, limit banner appeared with 'Zobacz Premium' button visible. Created a fresh premium test user via API (premium/subscribe), logged in via UI, chat header showed 'Premium · pozostało dziś: 10', decremented to 0 after 10 real sends, limit banner showed Premium-specific copy with NO 'Zobacz Premium' button (count=0). No 'bez limitu' text found anywhere in chat header, premium screen, or profile screen. /premium screen shows new perk 'Więcej rozmów z doradcą' / 'Do 10 wiadomości dziennie...' and old 'Bez limitu rozmów' text is gone. /profile non-premium subtitle shows 'zyskaj więcej rozmów z doradcą'. /legal and /legal/privacy load without auth with readable Polish content. app.json splash backgroundColor is #FA5252 as expected. Admin panel (/admin) loads correctly with user list, premium badges visible for the two test premium accounts created during this session, counts updated (41 users, 7 premium).
critical_code_review_comments: chat_limit_for/chat_remaining/reserve_chat correctly centralize the free-vs-premium cap in one place (server.py:682-702); reserve_chat atomically increments then rolls back on overflow, avoiding race conditions for concurrent requests.
refund_chat() on empty LLM response correctly restores the reserved quota slot (verified logic review; not independently forced since LLM calls succeeded in all test runs).
Frontend chat.tsx correctly branches on is_premium for both the header text (no more 'bez limitu') and the limit banner copy/CTA (chat-go-premium only rendered for !isPremium).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested checks across chat quota free/premium, premium screen, profile screen, legal pages, admin panel)

None of these affect ania_t1 or other seeded accounts. ania_t1's daily chat quota was consumed (4 messages sent during this test session, remaining now 0 for today) as part of verifying the free-user limit-hit banner.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat quota change (5 free / 10 premium, 429 on overflow, refund-on-empty-response) is verified correct on both backend (pytest) and frontend (live UI with real sends). ania_t1's chat quota is exhausted for today (remaining=0) from this test run - use a fresh TEST_ user or wait a day if retesting free-user chat quota with ania_t1. Legal pages, premium perks text, and profile subtitle text changes all verified rendering correctly with no crashes. Did not verify native app icon assets visually (not screenshot-testable per instructions) but confirmed app.json splash backgroundColor is #FA5252.
